senses.en_definition: To read and understand written or printed text, including Braille by touch.
To read aloud or recite a text, prayer, or verse.
To read and record the figures shown on a meter or measuring instrument.
To infer someone's character, thoughts, intentions, or attitude from outward signs.
To predict someone's fortune by interpreting the lines on their palm.

messages.en: Have you read the message in the group chat yet? We're meeting at eight, right?
Yeah, but check the latest message. Mira changed it to eight thirty because she's finishing work late.
Oh, I haven't read that one yet. Okay, I'll be there at eight thirty.

senses.en_definition: The physical body of a person or animal.
The trunk of the body, excluding the head and limbs.
The main structure or body of an object or vehicle.
An organization or agency established to carry out particular functions.
The main text or content of a speech, book, or document.

messages.en: Fancy another game of badminton this evening?
Oof, I'm still aching from yesterday's game. I'll take a rest today.
Okay, get some rest. We'll play again another time.

senses.en_definition: How; used to ask about a condition or situation.
How; in what way or by what means.

messages.en: Do you know how to fill in this section? I've tried, but I still don't get it.
Just put your home address there. If it doesn't fit, carry on in the space below.

collocations.en: in any case; no matter what

messages.en: It's pouring. Are you still going?
Yeah, I'm going anyway. I've already promised.
